sentences: Did you know Indy shooting the *swordsman* was *never* in the script?
Originally, Indy was supposed to fight him with his *whip*, in a long, multi-page fight.
But on the day of filming, *Harrison Ford* had terrible *dysentery*, and could barely stand.
So he asked *Spielberg*, why don't I just *shoot* him?
And it became one of the *funniest* scenes in movie history.
